chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Zareeh al-Muharibi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The world is the best of assistance for the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: How does the world assist in attaining the Hereafter according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) articulates the Shia principle of 'Istifadah' (utilization), affirming that the material world is not inherently opposed to spirituality but serves as a vital instrument for achieving eternal success. This teaching refutes ascetic isolationism, emphasizing that worldly resources, when directed with intention, facilitate religious duties and spiritual growth. The statement encapsulates the balanced worldview where the dunya is a means (wasila) rather than an end, aligning with the broader Shia emphasis on active engagement with society for divine purposes.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Zareeh Al Muharby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The best of the assistance is the world, upon (seeking) the Herefater’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Darih al-Muharibiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The worldly help in one’s quest for success in the hereafter is the best help.’”
